question: If job select creates two Hero tokens because of a doubling effect, is the Equipment attached to both of them?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the Equipment becomes attached to only one of them.
expected.answer: If the job select ability causes two Hero tokens to be created (due to an effect such as that of Doubling Season), the Equipment becomes attached to only one of them.

whyHard: Two tokens look like they can share the Equipment, but an Equipment is attached to one object.
